description: Walk the DNSSEC chain from the root to one answer: DS and DNSKEY at each signed zone cut, key tags, signers, signature windows, and the first link that breaks or goes insecure. Use it after check_domain's dnssec row fails or a resolver answers SERVFAIL, not for one signed record (dig) or the delegation (trace). Read through Cloudflare's resolver over DoH with CD=1 from the isitdns edge, with no key and a limit of 100 calls a minute per address. Signature bytes are not verified, so a clean walk does not prove the answer validates. type (default A) is the record checked at the end, not OPT, RRSIG or a meta type such as ANY.

name.description: The name, e.g. www.example.com. Also as "domain"; a URL is read as its host.

type.description: The record type to check at the end of the chain

name: dnssec_chain

answer.description: The end: rcode, records, signatures, denial, problems

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

firstBreak.description: The first link that breaks: at, why

insecureAt.description: The zone where it goes insecure

links.description: One per zone cut: zone, DS, key tags and roles, signer, problems

receipts.description: One per DNS read: what, of whom, from where, when, rcode, flags, EDE, ms, answer

signaturesVerified.description: Always false: signature bytes are not checked

title: Walk the DNSSEC chain
